entities.summary: Ron Athey is an American performance artist associated with body art and with extreme performance art and is said to be a "central figure in the development of live art." He has performed in the U.S. and internationally. Athey's work explores challenging subjects like the relationships between desire, sexuality and traumatic experience. Many of his works include aspects of S&M in order to confront preconceived ideas about the body in relation to masculinity and religious iconography. Ron Athey was a authors & novelists from Groton (b. 1961-12-16, Groton). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a central figure in the development of live art, Ron Athey's performances have influenced contemporary performance art and challenged societal norms around desire, sexuality, and trauma. His work has had a significant impact on the LGBTQ+ community and the art world.
